intuition: Buffering one upcoming value lets peek inspect it without advancing the underlying iterator.

brute_force.approach: Copy all values from the iterator into a list before supporting lookahead.

optimal.approach: Keep a single cached value and refill it from the wrapped iterator only when needed.
optimal.time: peek O(1), next O(1), hasNext O(1)

edge_cases: Repeated peek calls return the same cached item.
next is called only when hasNext is true.
